critic_issues.problem: The line says "Drone reveals at 150 m. Concealed units stay hidden until they fire." The second sentence contradicts the first. During Scouting the drone reveals units within 150 m whether or not they have fired. The line also reads as a rules tooltip, not terse radio voice.
critic_issues.gdd: Infantry in cover stay concealed until they fire, an enemy comes within 100 m, or a recon drone spots them; the enemy scout drone reveals within **150 m**
critic_issues.fix: Use an in-voice line that doesn't restate the rule, e.g. "Scout drone on the line. Anything inside 150 m gets seen. Keep low, hold fire."

critic_issues.problem: "Fire only when they close inside 100 m" misuses the 100 m figure. In the GDD it is a reveal trigger for concealed infantry, not a rule for when to open fire. It also conflicts with the ranges (small arms 180 m, Javelin and vehicles 300 m) and with the AT instruction to hold fire only "until vehicles are in range".
critic_issues.gdd: Ranges: small arms 180, HMG 220, RPG 180, vehicles 300, Javelin 300 m; infantry in cover stay concealed until they fire, an enemy is within 100 m, or a recon drone spots them
critic_issues.fix: Reword to "Stay concealed in cover through the bombardment. Do not fire early; firing gives away your position."

critic_issues.problem: "Rifles do not hurt it" is too broad. The GDD has three armour classes: HMG handles light armour, and rifles are soft-skin only.
critic_issues.gdd: Three armour classes: rifles vs soft-skin only, HMG vs light armour, AT/drones vs heavy
critic_issues.fix: "Save anti-tank weapons and drones for the heavy armour. Rifles will not stop it."

critic_issues.problem: "north-east" and "beyond the ridge" are invented geography. The GDD excerpts give no approach direction or ridge for FlatTest, and the NE village-grid scene is parked. The briefing title "Village Approach" has the same problem.
critic_issues.gdd: GDD 07 describes the shipped FlatTest; the NE village-grid scene is parked
critic_issues.fix: Drop the compass direction and ridge, or take them from the FlatTest map doc. For example: "Enemy assault expected on our front."

critic_issues.problem: "{vehicle} destroyed. Crew status unknown." reads as a friendly loss. Lines [1] ("Confirmed kill") and [2] ("{zone} is clear of armour") read as enemy kills. One event key therefore mixes friendly and enemy perspectives.
critic_issues.fix: Make all three lines enemy kills (e.g. "Enemy {vehicle} destroyed. Crew bailed."), or split friendly and enemy loss into separate keys.

critic_issues.problem: "bearing {zone}" mixes a compass bearing with a zone placeholder, so the output will read oddly (e.g. "bearing Zone B").
{count} may be 1, which gives "1 casualties", "1 men down" or "1 infantry on foot". "FPV" is also a drone type the excerpted GDD never defines.
critic_issues.fix: Use count-neutral wording, e.g. "Casualties: {count}.", and say "Drone impact at {zone}."

critic_issues.problem: "Fire mission on …" is used in both the phase radio and the event log, so the phrasing repeats. The phase line also says "our trenches", which the shipped FlatTest may not have.
critic_issues.fix: Vary one of them, e.g. "Rounds landing on the line. Stay down, then be ready."

briefing.title: Hold the Line: Village Approach
lines: Enemy assault expected from the north-east. Two waves: infantry first, armour and mechanized after.
Hold the line. Do not let any enemy unit reach the deployment zone.
Stay concealed in cover through the bombardment. Fire only when they close inside 100 m.
Save anti-tank weapons and drones for the armour. Rifles do not hurt it.
Orders: W forward, H hold, S back, R retreat. Drones 1 to 6, then click the map.

Intel: HQ to all stations. Enemy assault forming up beyond the ridge. Expect contact soon.
Stay concealed. Hold your positions and keep radio discipline.
Reports of vehicles and infantry massing. Two waves expected.
Scouting: Enemy scout drone overhead. Stay in cover and do not fire.
Drone reveals at 150 m. Concealed units stay hidden until they fire.
Recon drone on the line. Hold fire, keep heads down.
Bombardment: Artillery on revealed positions. Stay in cover and hold.
Shelling on the line. Do not move into the open.
Fire mission on our trenches. Wait it out, then be ready.
VehicleAdvance: Enemy armour on the road. Anti-tank teams, hold fire until in range.
Armour closing. Drones and Javelin teams to targets. Rifles stay down.
Tracked vehicles advancing. Do not waste AT on soft-skin.
MechanizedInfantry: Transports halting. Infantry dismounting short of the line.
Enemy infantry on foot. Hold the line, use drones on the open ground.
Dismounted infantry advancing. Fire on my mark, stay in cover.

squad_lost: {squad} is gone. No contact on net.
vehicle_destroyed: Vehicle down: {vehicle}. {zone} is clear of armour.
drone_hit: Drone hit confirmed on {enemy}. Effect on target.
artillery_incoming: Fire mission on {unit}'s position. Impact in seconds.
transport_unloading: Transports unloading at {distance} m. {count} infantry on foot.
Dismount at {distance} m. Expect infantry on {zone}.

output.routing_message: The enemy is routing — victory is near.

critic_issues.problem: The phase order runs VehicleAdvance, then MechanizedInfantry, with transports unloading infantry. The briefing says 'infantry first, armour and mechanized after.' Both are allowed: the GDD keeps infantry-first pacing until transports carry infantry. But the briefing says mechanized comes last, and the radio presents unloading transports as the final phase. A player could read this as armour arriving first. The briefing and the phase order don't agree.
critic_issues.gdd: Order of phases 4–5: armour leads once transports carry infantry (tickets N180 → N182); until then the prototype's infantry-first pacing stands.
critic_issues.fix: Reword briefing.lines[0] to match the phase order, e.g. 'Two waves expected. Armour and mechanized infantry follow the first push.' Or drop the wave order from the briefing.

critic_issues.problem: 'Tracked vehicles advancing' is too narrow. The Russian roster includes wheeled vehicles such as the BTR-3E stand-in, which is tinted Russian, so the line can be wrong.
critic_issues.gdd: Keep the BTR-3E stand-in, tinted Russian.

critic_issues.problem: 'Fire on my mark' implies HQ gives fire-control orders. The game has only four orders (Forward/Hold/Back/Retreat), and units fight on their own within them.
critic_issues.gdd: Units never abandon their order, but they fight intelligently inside it.
critic_issues.fix: Use e.g. 'Dismounted infantry advancing. Hold the line, stay in cover.'

critic_issues.problem: '{zone} is clear of armour' asserts something the game may not know. Other enemy vehicles can still be in the zone. 'Crew bailed' in [0] also assumes crew survive.
critic_issues.fix: Use 'Enemy vehicle down: {vehicle}, {zone}.' Replace 'Crew bailed' with a neutral 'Kill confirmed.'

critic_issues.problem: 'Drone hit confirmed on {enemy}. Effect on target.' nearly repeats [0] ('Drone strike on {enemy}. Target hit.'). 'Effect on target' is filler.
critic_issues.fix: Make it distinct, e.g. 'Drone hit on {enemy}. {count} down.'

critic_issues.problem: 'Casualties: {count}' does not say whose casualties. That is ambiguous for a player drone strike versus an enemy one.
'Fire mission on {unit}'s position' is the term for calling in your own fire. Here it reads as friendly fire support rather than an incoming enemy strike.
critic_issues.gdd: Bombardment. Artillery or drone strikes on revealed positions.
critic_issues.fix: Use 'Enemy fire mission on {unit}'s position. Impact in seconds.' or 'Incoming on {unit}'s position. Take cover.'

critic_issues.problem: 'Recon drone on the line. Hold fire, keep heads down.' is a near-duplicate of Scouting[0] and [1]. It also calls the enemy scout a 'recon drone', and the GDD uses 'recon drone' for the player's spotter.
critic_issues.gdd: Infantry in cover stay concealed until they fire, an enemy comes within 100 m, or a recon drone spots them; the enemy scout drone reveals within 150 m.
critic_issues.fix: Replace it with a new point, e.g. 'Spotted units will draw fire. Stay hidden until contact.'

critic_issues.problem: 'Stay down, then be ready.' is vague and could fit any game.
critic_issues.fix: Use 'Rounds on the line. Expect armour when it lifts.'
